findings: prepareForSearch launches caller-scope work without retaining a Job or generation token. Overlapping preparations or reset can be followed by an older result overwriting state. This is a source-level race; no Android scheduling reproduction was run.

prepareForSearch and prepareWithPreFilteredList calculate for an empty query but preserve existing searchQuery in copied state, allowing displayed query and results to disagree when the manager is reused.
observeAllFolders().first() takes one snapshot without observing later folder changes. No freshness or failure handling surrounds preparation; an exception can leave isLoading true.

updateSearchQuery filters and sorts the complete folder list synchronously in StateFlow.update; the calculationContext dispatcher is used only for initial preparation. Large-list typing latency is unmeasured.

FolderSearchDialog eagerly composes all results in a scrolling Column rather than a lazy list. Confirmation is enabled solely by non-null browsePath, including while loading; caller validation remains to be checked.
Browse direct-child comparison ignores case while root-parent membership and exclusion sets use exact case. Selection label truncates to the last 35 characters; several strings are hardcoded English.
